title: Protective enclosures and types of environment
rows: Protected against solid objects over 1 mm (tools, wires, and small wires), Protection against water sprayed from all directions - limited ingress permitted. Indoor, dust-prone areas
Protected against dust limited ingress (no harmful deposit), Protection against water sprayed from all directions - limited ingress permitted.
Protected against dust limited ingress (no harmful deposit), Protected against low pressure jets of water from all directions - limited ingress.
Protected against ingress of any dust while exposed and sewage or sludge while submerged
markdown:
| Type | Enclo-sure type | Description of environment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Screen-protected drip proof | IP.11 | Indoor, clean(dust free) environment |
| Totally enclosed, air cooled | IP.44 | Protected against solid objects over 1 mm (tools, wires, and small wires), Protection against water sprayed from all directions - limited ingress permitted. Indoor, dust-prone areas |
| Totally Enclosed, Fan cooled, | IP.54 | Protected against dust limited ingress (no harmful deposit), Protection against water sprayed from all directions - limited ingress permitted. |
| Outdoor application | IP.55 | Protected against dust limited ingress (no harmful deposit), Protected against low pressure jets of water from all directions - limited ingress. |
| Submersible application | IP 68 | Protected against ingress of any dust while exposed and sewage or sludge while submerged |
notes: Source:CPHEEO, 1993 (printed without a space after the colon)
The second header is printed on three lines as 'Enclo-', '-sure', 'type'; it is transcribed as 'Enclo-sure type' to avoid an embedded line break.

Printed capitalisation and punctuation are retained: 'Totally enclosed, air cooled' versus 'Totally Enclosed, Fan cooled,' (trailing comma), 'IP.11' to 'IP.55' with a point but 'IP 68' without, and the fourth row ending '- limited ingress.' without 'permitted'.
Draft only: unit existence in the built index was not checked, because data/build is out of scope for this batch.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi full-page PNGs and 288-300 dpi region crops, with sideways pages rotated upright before reading; no OCR, no native-text values, no paid service
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every cell, power, dash, blank and footnote was read from the image and retained as printed; printed anomalies are listed in notes and were not corrected.
